theorem lg_target {k : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :

  let s : ℂ := -↑k
  let a : ℝ := ↑x
  have hs : 1 < s.re := by
    rw [s]
    simp only [Real.cast_neg, Real.cast_one, Real.cast_add, Real.cast_nat, Real.cast_zero]
    exact lt_of_le_of_gt (le_zero_iff.mp (Nat.le_zero_iff.mpr (Nat.succ_pos k))) (by simp)

  have h1 : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta a s = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) :=
    by

      have h3 : HasSum (fun n => 1 / (↑n + ↑a) ^ s - 1 / (↑n + 1 - ↑a) ^ s) (HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (↑a) s - HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (↑(1 - a)) s) :=
        by
          refine hasSum_sub h2 _
          apply HurwitzZeta.hasSum_hurwitzZeta_of_one_lt_re
          · exact a
          · exact ha
          · refine ⟨_, _, _⟩
            · exact s
            · exact hs
      have h4 : HasSum (fun n => (1 / (↑n + ↑a) ^ s - 1 / (↑n + 1 - ↑a) ^ s) / 2) (HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (↑a) s - HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (↑(1 - a)) s) / 2 :=
        by
          refine hasSum_div_const _ 2
          exact h3

                rw [h5]
                rw [hasSum_eq]
                rw [hasSum_eq]
                rw [eq.symm (hasSum_eq h4 h5)]
                rfl
              · rw [HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZetaOdd_def]
                rfl
